description: Scratchpad is a note-taking app for text, files, PDFs, recordings, and shared or published notes, with sync across devices. It also offers AI features, including an MCP server so external assistants can search, read, and write notes with user-approved permissions.
summary: Scratchpad exposes two developer integration surfaces on app.scratchpad.sh: a bearer-token HTTP API at `/api` and an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at `/api/mcp`; docs also show the `claude` CLI command used to add the MCP server in Claude Code.

surfaces.name: Claude Code MCP client command for Scratchpad
